description:
Transcribe an audio file to text using Mistral Voxtral.

Accepted models:
  - voxtral-mini-latest
  - voxtral-small-latest

Audio source is one of:
  - { type: "file_url", fileUrl: "https://..." }  (public URL)
  - { type: "file", fileId: "<id-from-files-api>" }

Options:
  - `language`: ISO-639-1 hint (e.g. 'fr', 'en'). Boosts accuracy when known.
  - `temperature`: sampling temperature.
  - `diarize`: return per-speaker segments (default false).
  - `timestampGranularities`: ['segment'] to return per-segment timestamps.
  - `contextBias`: list of phrases/terms that should bias the decoder.

Returns plain `text`, detected `language`, optional `segments[]`, and token usage.

fileUrl.description: HTTPS URL to an audio file (mp3/wav/flac/ogg/webm/m4a).

type.description: Transcribe audio from the URL in fileUrl.

fileId.description: ID of an audio file previously uploaded via the Files API (purpose=audio).

type.description: Transcribe an uploaded audio file identified by fileId.

audio.description: Audio to transcribe, supplied as a public URL or an uploaded file ID.

contextBias.description: Words or phrases to favor when decoding the audio.

diarize.description: Identify speakers in the returned transcription segments. Defaults to false.

name: voxtral_transcribe
title: Voxtral speech-to-text
